mapper.select: SELECT cp.post_id, cp.user_idx, u.nickname, u.account_status, cp.title, cp.content, cp.created_at, cpd.region, cpd.post_type, cpd.post_status, cpd.view_count, cpd.like_count, cpd.comment_count, cpd.updated_at FROM COMMUNITY_POST cp JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_DETAIL cpd ON cp.post_id = cpd.post_id LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cp.user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE cp.post_id = #{postId} AND cpd.post_status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT image_id, post_id, image_url, sort_order FROM COMMUNITY_POST_IMAGE WHERE post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT ct.tag_name FROM COMMUNITY_POST_TAG cpt JOIN COMMUNITY_TAG ct ON cpt.tag_id = ct.tag_id WHERE cpt.post_id = #{postId}

SELECT cc.comment_id, cc.post_id, cc.user_idx, u.nickname, cc.content, cc.comment_status, cc.like_count, cc.created_at, cc.updated_at, cc.parent_comment_id, u.account_status FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT cc LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cc.user_idx = u.user_idx WHERE cc.post_id = #{postId} AND cc.comment_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'BLOCKED') ORDER BY COALESCE(cc.parent_comment_id, cc.comment_id), cc.comment_id ASC

SELECT cp.post_id, cp.user_idx, u.nickname, cp.title, cp.created_at, cpd.post_type, cpd.like_count, cpi.image_url AS thumb_url, SUM(ctr.co_count) AS total_co_count FROM COMMUNITY_POST cp JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_DETAIL cpd ON cp.post_id = cpd.post_id LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cp.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_IMAGE cpi ON cp.post_id = cpi.post_id AND cpi.sort_order = 1 JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_TAG cpt_other ON cp.post_id = cpt_other.post_id JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_TAG cpt_mine ON cpt_mine.post_id = #{postId} JOIN COMMUNITY_TAG_RELATION ctr ON ( (ctr.tag_id_a = cpt_mine.tag_id AND ctr.tag_id_b = cpt_other.tag_id) OR (ctr.tag_id_b = cpt_mine.tag_id AND ctr.tag_id_a = cpt_other.tag_id) ) WHERE cpd.post_status = 'ACTIVE' AND cp.post_id != #{postId} GROUP BY cp.post_id, cp.user_idx, u.nickname, cp.title, cp.created_at, cpd.post_type, cpd.like_count, cpi.image_url ORDER BY total_co_count DESC, cpd.like_count DESC, cp.created_at DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT cp.post_id, cp.user_idx, u.nickname, cp.title, cp.created_at, cpd.post_type, cpd.like_count, cpd.comment_count, u.account_status, cpi.image_url AS thumb_url FROM COMMUNITY_POST cp JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_DETAIL cpd ON cp.post_id = cpd.post_id LEFT JOIN USERS u ON cp.user_idx = u.user_idx LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_POST_IMAGE cpi ON cp.post_id = cpi.post_id AND cpi.sort_order = 1 WHERE cpd.post_status IN ('ACTIVE', 'DORMANT') ORDER BY cpd.like_count DESC, cp.created_at DESC LIMIT 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_POST (user_idx, title, content, created_at) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{title}, #{content}, NOW())
INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_POST_DETAIL (post_id, region, post_type, post_status, view_count, like_count, comment_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{region}, #{postType}, 'ACTIVE', 0, 0, 0, NOW())
INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_POST_IMAGE (post_id, image_url, sort_order) VALUES (#{postId}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder})
INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_TAG (tag_name, use_count, created_at) VALUES (#{tagName}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE use_count = use_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT tag_id FROM COMMUNITY_TAG WHERE tag_name = #{tagName}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO COMMUNITY_POST_TAG (post_id, tag_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{tagId})

INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_TAG_RELATION (tag_id_a, tag_id_b, co_count, updated_at) VALUES ( LEAST(#{tagIdA}, #{tagIdB}), GREATEST(#{tagIdA}, #{tagIdB}), 1, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE co_count = co_count + 1, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMUNITY_POST_DETAIL SET post_status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO COMMUNITY_POST_LIKE (post_id, user_idx, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userIdx}, NOW())
INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_COMMENT (post_id, user_idx, content, comment_status, like_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userIdx}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE', 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMUNITY_COMMENT SET comment_status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT post_id FROM COMMUNITY_COMMENT WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO COMMUNITY_REPORT (post_id, user_idx, reason, status, created_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userIdx}, 'other', 'pending', NOW())
INSERT IGNORE INTO COMMUNITY_COMMENT_LIKE (comment_id, user_idx, created_at) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userIdx}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMUNITY_POST_DETAIL SET region = #{region}, post_type = #{postType}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
UPDATE COMMUNITY_POST_QUESTION SET accepted_comment_id = #{commentId}, is_solved = 1, solved_at = NOW() WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY_COMMENT (post_id, user_idx, content, comment_status, like_count, parent_comment_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userIdx}, #{content}, 'ACTIVE', 0, #{parentCommentId}, NOW(), NOW())
